name: Eyes of the Crafter

facts.text: The Eyes as the hall's lenses turned on the fort, and the cabalist's habit of looking through them, are Living Server writing.

story:
The school of making kept a pair of great lenses on the roof of its hall, the gift of the college of stars, so that the makers could study their work by the light of noon in every corner of the workshop. The drakoran cabalist who answers to Meical's name took the lenses down, set them in a body of iron and crystal, and taught the thing to walk. He calls it the Eyes of the Crafter, and it watches the fort.

It stands beside the hall among the numbered sentries, faced toward Fort Gwyntell on its winnowing hill, and the cabalist looks through it when he wants to know who is coming. The garrison say they can feel it on the back of the neck. Adelon on the hill right of the fort gate, who watches the hall, says the Eyes watch Adelon back, and that it is a long time since anybody in the dales was alone.

The sentries round it are the cabalist's, and so is the Eyes, by the same allegiance; strike one and the hall's servants all turn their heads. The cabalist himself is never far.
legend: Eyes of the Crafter, level 48, faction Meical, right beside the hall of making with numbered sentries, heavy metal and Cabalist Meical (58) close. Pull it out to the slope: anything of Meical's faction nearby comes too, and you do not want the cabalist. Plain melee, no spells. Respawn 80 seconds. The fort's garrison say it watches them; it does nothing about it.
